name: Mansa
assessment: The public no-www NSDI endpoint returns complete bounded cadastral lot geometry. The first center-relative nine-cell audit verified all 86 UPIDs, but the wider aligned app-cell audit exposed two different plots sharing MAN/350. They are disjoint and carry different survey references (138/67 versus 23/71), survey dates and survey areas. A shared UPID alone is therefore insufficient to establish one stable ground parcel in the tested app area.
technicalBlockers: Native UPID MAN/350 identifies two spatially separate survey records with inconsistent survey references. A publisher-supported identity/lifecycle rule separating them is not established.
decisions: No transport OBJECTID is used as native identity.
No arbitrary survey year or row is selected.
No unproven compound identity or multipart merge is enabled.
The temporary qualified-field adapter prototype was removed after source qualification failed; the existing production adapter was left unchanged.
nextStep: Find a publisher-documented native plot identity/lifecycle rule or another source that disambiguates the two survey records, then rerun the aligned app-cell and full exact-ID acceptance.
